email_subject: Possible adverse event report - Demo Cardolol patient with a mild skin rash

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 26-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their first dose of Demo Cardolol (dose: 25mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-06-09.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Haddad (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
